title: Mixed Event — Singing in Sync — Episode2 Missing Voice

meta.Event Outline: As Vivid BAD SQUAD takes its first steps, An and Kohane are both fully confident that they have the best partner in one another. However, the two partners quickly find themselves hitting a snag. Will they be able to get through it?!

rows.Line: The day of the show
STAY GOLDEN Venue

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh wow, it's so packed...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place is buzzing with energy! If I weren't already fired up for this, I'd definitely be now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (How can they be unfazed by all this...?)

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line:
Hey! Akito, Toya!
You guys gonna be okay against this lineup?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pfft... Dude, we're gonna make fans from other groups come flock to us instead.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It doesn't matter who we're up against. We're not losing to anyone!

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: An! Good luck! I'll be cheering for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! This is gonna be our best show ever! Get ready for a wild ride!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow, An and the guys are already well-known here. I need to do a good job today to get my name out there too.)

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: Hey, it's Kohane! I saw you at your other gig. Keep it up, girl!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Er... Thank you, I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The other contestants all have solid reputations...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we've got Vivid and BAD DOGS fans cheering for us today! This feels awesome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Hey! We're about to get this show rolling, so let's hear some noise!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it's time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's go and sing our hearts out!
We'll make the audience go crazy for us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Coming up next is EVER, a strong favorite in today's battle!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did you guys feel that just now...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... They only just started, but everyone's already being blown away...

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: Your awesome cheers are music to our ears! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: Lots of folks are saying we're favorites and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: But hey, we don't wanna discourage the guys singing after us. They could be some hot stuff too, who knows, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: Show us what you got!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What a performance...!
They just sent this place sky high!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we're the ones who're gonna make the audience really explode.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're really quiet, Kohane. Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to sing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to get on that stage and sing...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...
Yeah, don't we all!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Guys, get ready. We're next.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Let's do our best, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're winning this one! No doubt about it!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next is Vivid BAD SQUAD, a group of four high schoolers. They're a new name on the scene, but already creating a huge buzz!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, hey, hey! Thank you for coming!
We're Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: C'mon, make some noise! Are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We're starting off with a good vibe...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (All that's left is to sing our hearts out...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line: These guys are amazing!

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: These guys are high schoolers?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We nailed the intro!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Great, Kohane seems to be enjoying it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We've got the audience hooked. So far so good!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, hey! So you like our songs? That was just a warm-up! Now, we're gonna kick it up a notch!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(That was good...
I've gotta step it up too!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We can't let Shiraishi just leave us in the back!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow...! The crowd's so fired up, I'm starting to feel it too!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An, Aoyagi and Shinonome are really awesome! I have to do my best to keep up!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, what's happening? I can't sing as well as when we were rehearsing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, I get it. It's because the audience is so loud, it's drowning out everyone's voices!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do I do...?! This is bad...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's no use... I can't hear An clearly enough...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (What's up with Kohane...?!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She missed her cue...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(The next part's the most important...!
We'll have to sing it without her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, we can't leave Kohane behind...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm gonna help her!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What's An doing?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This is bad... If An backs up Kohane, the chorus is gonna lose its punch!)

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line:
Hey, what's going on...?
Don't they sound off all the sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: Yeah, they were so good until just now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No...! We're at the end of the song...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In the unlikely event that something does go wrong, I'll cover for you and get you back on track, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I couldn't do anything to help...!)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: That was Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line:
That's a weak applause, but it figures.
They totally fell apart at the end.

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: Yeah, but they were pretty good for most of it...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, who can rev up this event more than EVER?! Let's see what our next contestants have to offer!
